searchText: Awesome, I see that the main change is the port to use 8550 instead of 8551, is this configurable in besu ? This is on msf4 right after the merge. I was getting these warnings for about 20 minutes. After that it was fine. Having said that... I am getting this warning in lighthouse once or twice per hour: `May 13 04:54:07.773 WARN Error whilst processing payload status error: Api { id: "http://127.0.0.1:62003/", error: Reqwest(reqwest::Error { kind: Request, url: Url { scheme: "http", cannot_be_a_base: false, username: "", password: None, host: Some(Ipv4(127.0.0.1)), port: Some(62003), path: "/", query: None, fragment: None }, source: TimedOut }) }, service: exec` I did not see it on kiln. Working on Besu integration in Hive, and I have some doubts about a test `Two Block Re-org to Lower-Height Chain` , anyone can help me? <@892053833121923094> maybe? Sure, what’s the issue ? yes it is, we are also in the process of consolidating everything to a single engine port, which will be 8551. is anyone from Nimbus available to check out the nimbus-besu node for mnsf4? nimbus is spamming besu with the same FCU call repeatedly. checking ``` DBG 2022-05-13 13:47:38.584+00:00 runForkChoiceUpdated: running forkchoiceUpdated headBlockRoot=4fa5e8c0 finalizedBlockRoot=00000000 DBG 2022-05-13 13:47:38.584+00:00 runForkChoiceUpdated: forkchoiceUpdated failed err="Transport is not initialised (missing a call to connect?)" DBG 2022-05-13 13:47:44.460+00:00 runForkChoiceUpdated: running forkchoiceUpdated headBlockRoot=04bf69fe finalizedBlockRoot=00000000 DBG 2022-05-13 13:47:44.460+00:00 runForkChoiceUpdated: forkchoiceUpdated failed err="Transport is not initialised (missing a call to connect?)" ``` ? but it was connected until recently ``` DBG 2022-05-13 13:58:21.299+00:00 newPayload failed msg="Could not send packet because of [AsyncStreamIncompleteError]: Incomplete data sent or received" DBG 2022-05-13 13:58:21.299+00:00 runQueueProcessingLoop: execution payload accepted or syncing executionPayloadStatus=SYNCING ``` <@827653956955406406> looking at Besu logs, I see ``` java.util.concurrent.CompletionException: org.hyperledger.besu.ethereum.eth.sync.backwardsync.BackwardSyncException: Did not receive a ... ``` repeatedly, which might be related. Nimbus seems to have difficulty recovering from this `AsyncStreamIncompleteError` yes, it is stuck in a backwards sync and can't find a block it wants
